TipHow to set up the calendar (delete this box when done)






Open Google Calendar, click the gear icon, then Settings.
Under Settings for my calendars, pick the calendar (or create a new one named “American Beaver Party”).
Under Access permissions, check Make available to public.
Under Integrate calendar, copy the Calendar ID and paste it in place of YOUR_CALENDAR_ID%40group.calendar.google.com above (keep %40 in place of the @).
Change ctz= to your time zone, and change mode=AGENDA to MONTH or WEEK if you prefer.

title: The American Beaver Party
text:
Not feeling represented by your government? True democracy is the answer.
Join the Party
Welcome! We are the American Beaver Party. We believe in true democracy, and we trust in people to choose how to govern themselves. The American Beaver Party understands how important it is that every person has an equal say in their countries practices. We know that when it comes to the government, the most important opinion is yours!

title: The American Beaver Party
text:
What we stand for:



Democracy
We want to transition from a Lockean political philosophy to a Roussoian; which gives the control of Government to the people. Personal restrictions and government direction should be determined by general agreement.



Economy
We support the transition to an economy that does not expand but rather normalizes in a prosperous position. Our goal is to stabilize interest rates, inflation and Government spending. We want to closely controlled and regulate large corporations, while small businesses operate lais-sez-faire with removal of impediments to production.



Energy
We believe in the nationalization of electrical energy, petroleum industry, aerospace, electronic connectivity (Data Centers) and the pursuit and exploration of artificial intelligence and its use. All systems should be under the control of and for the benefit of the general public.

title: About the American Beaver Party
text:
The American Beaver Party Platform may appear radical in ideology but it is not. Some of the Platform positions are progressive and designed as aspirational. Progress is made in baby steps and some of the positions need time to develop. It is the goal of the Party to maintain the existing political and economic structure and work slowly in regards to change.
One of the most fundamental transitions is conversion to a political system that is based on the input and direction of the people. The influence on decision making will always be in conjunction with the desires of the general public. The Platform presented is both liberal and conservative and designed to be centric and inclusive to all of the citizens of America.

title: Our Beliefs
text: Below are some concepts we at the American Beaver Party strongly believe in and fight to support. More, in-depth outlines can be found on any of our social media sites below. Stay tuned for new updates.

title: Our Beliefs
text:
Regarding Economy:
The economy is a tool of the people and should be designed to provide a simple uncomplicated pathway to prosperity. Economy is not the goal but rather a bridge to the development and enjoyment of an enriched life. Creating a maintenance economy where energy, interest rates, cost of goods and inflation remain fixed at the lowest levels possible is the duty of good government. Accomplishing this requires a transition in thought. People need to understand that the goal is not the pursuit of money but rather embracing a beautiful and loving personality. The economy should support that goal.

title: Our Beliefs
text:
Regarding Energy:
In pursuit of an economy that remains constant, energy management is crucial. Electrical energy needs to be cheap and plentiful. Once established, the demand for energy remains constant. Transition to energy sources that protect the environment as much as possible. All aspects of energy generation, transmission and procurement are owned and controlled by the general public. Facilitating this transition, the general public also owns and controls the oil and gas industries. All prices are stabilized and constant without reason. Export and import of oil is limited and in support of our trading partners. Any profit derived would be a public benefit. Local electrical energy is the advanced solution to energy production, environmental protections and prosperous local economies. Energy, food and shelter are the foundation of the economy and when all are healthy prosperity soon follows; with prosperity comes a renaissance.

title: Our Beliefs
text:
Regarding the United Nations:
The United Nations is an invaluable tool that can be used to solve international issues and conflicts. It is mandatory that we reconstruct this organization by eliminating the impediments to action. Redesigned as an organization providing an open forum for addressing grievances, advancement of creative solutions, shared reasoning, collective decision making and the ability to enforce action. The United Nations, with proper application, may well divide the world into two orders. One that supports a democratic world, where people are free to determine their own destiny and another that wants to subjugate people into a controlled existence. How these two world orders interact and communicate with each other is the function of the United Nations. There are no solutions to conflict without the United Nations, excepting enduring war. The United Nations presents a democratic process for peaceful existence for all the countries of the world. It is not a perfect solution but if we can arrive at coexistence without war and destruction, we win. Those Nations that continue to imprison the minds of their people must be given the respect and time to evolve, for the sake of the people governed. Likewise, the Nations who provide liberty for their people can pursue life without the constant threat of hostile action.

We’re a new party, and our platform is written with members. Join us and make your voice heard.
